lines_of_business: All lines of business unless noted in Program Exceptions; FEP follows FEP guidelines; SAO follows SAO guidelines; Medicare Advantage references NCD 240.4 and LCDs L33718/L33800
sections_in_order: Continued coverage beyond first three months
criteria_location: Position Statement (pp. ~2-6) holds initial-therapy criteria per device/diagnosis; continued coverage, replacement, accessories follow as sub-headings of the same section; Documentation Required and Definitions (AHI, EDS = ESS>=10, hypopnea) are separate later sections and change how the criteria are read.
procedures_covered: Bi-level without backup E0470 (OSA after CPAP failure; restrictive thoracic, severe COPD, CSA, hypoventilation)
Bi-level with backup E0471 (non-OSA only; ASV)
Accessories A4604, A7027-A7046 with quantity limits
Investigational: nasal EPAP (A7049), oral pressure therapy, positional electrical devices (E0530), PAP cleaners

logic.top_level: pathways (one block per device x diagnosis group, each with own all/any criteria) plus a separate continued-coverage time-gated block

k_of_n.quote: AHI ... of 5 or more but less than 15 in adult members with symptomatic OSA (...); OR AHI, RDI, or REI of 15 or more in adult members with symptomatic or asymptomatic OSA
k_of_n.quote_note: inner symptom list is any-of 7 (EDS, cognition, mood, insomnia, HTN, IHD, stroke)

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Scattered: E0471 'does not meet the definition of medical necessity for the treatment of obstructive sleep apnea'; ASV 'should not be used' with symptomatic CHF and LVEF <=45% (a NOTE, not formal criterion); investigational device list; billing note denies E0471 with OSA ICD-10 codes.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Yes. First 90 days vs continued coverage (adherence); switching CPAP to bi-level after >3 months needs new face-to-face but no new sleep test and restarts 3-month trial; failed trial allows re-qualification after face-to-face re-evaluation; replacement rules (nonfunctioning & out of warranty OR >5 years).

and_or_ambiguity.quote: adenotonsillectomy has been unsuccessful or is contraindicated, or when definitive surgery is indicated but must wait complete dental and facial development
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Third list item contains 'or' and a second 'or' inside; unclear grouping of the three alternatives

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Nonfunctioning and out of warranty or Device is greater than five years old
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Bullets; is 'out of warranty' attached to both? Reads as (nonfunctioning AND out of warranty) OR >5 yrs but not certain

and_or_ambiguity.quote: An E0471 device meets the definition of medical necessity for either criterion I or II
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Criterion I uses 'both criteria A and B'; criterion II is a different population; letters/numerals reused across sub-sections

and_or_ambiguity.quote: when A, B AND either criterion C or D are met
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Clear but only in prose; the list itself shows A. B. C. D. flat

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: HCPCS E0601/E0470/E0471 are named in headings of the criteria blocks; ICD-10 (G47.30, G47.33, G47.39, R40.0) listed as 'support medical necessity' but not tied to a specific criterion except an E0471 denial note; accessory quantity table tied to codes.
codes.non_covered_code_lists: A7047, A7049, E0530 marked Investigational; E0600/A7002 mentioned for oral pressure therapy

external_dependencies.what: Medicare Advantage: NCD 240.4, LCD L33718, L33800
external_dependencies.quote: Continuous Positive Airway Pressure (CPAP) Therapy for Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA) (240.4)

external_dependencies.what: FEP and SAO follow own guidelines
external_dependencies.quote: Federal Employee Program (FEP): Follow FEP guidelines.

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: Score greater than or equal to 10 on the Epworth Sleepiness Scale.
the total number of recorded events ... must be at least ... greater than or equal to 10 events
AHI greater than or equal to 5 but less than 15 is considered mild OSA

vague_terms.problem: Symptomatic is defined by a parenthetical 'evidence suggestive of' list, not a test; EDS defined by ESS>=10 only in Definitions

vague_terms.quote: tried and proven ineffective or is not tolerated as documented by a qualified health professional
vague_terms.problem: No definition of ineffective or intolerance, nor minimum trial length

vague_terms.quote: Significant improvement of the sleep-associated hypoventilation
chronic obstructive pulmonary disease does not contribute significantly
at the clinical discretion of the prescribing qualified healthcare professional
vague_terms.problem: ASV with LVEF >45% left to discretion

vague_terms.quote: usual maximum amount of accessories expected to be medically necessary
vague_terms.problem: 'usual' is soft; above is 'subject to medical review'

extraction_hazards: Bullets with 'OR' at line end; indented sub-lists with a/b/c, A/B/C, I/II, 1-4 lettering reused
Criteria inside NOTEs (ASV/CHF caution, pediatric AHI) and in Definitions section
Page-header navigation links and disclaimer at top
Accessory quantity table and LOINC tables flatten to columns
'f ace-to-face' split word and typos ('is meets', 'Win-x')
Footnote asterisk on E0471 in coding table carries a denial rule tied to ICD-10 list
Continued coverage and Documentation Required in separate sections from initial criteria
interesting_structures: Staged approval: 90-day rental, adherence check between day 31-91, then purchase authorization
Device-switching rules (CPAP to bi-level) that depend on when the switch occurs (before vs after 3 months)
ICD-10 deny rule for E0471 + OSA codes
Different thresholds for adult vs pediatric, weight gate

fit_to_tree.why: Each device x diagnosis block is a clean all/any tree, but time-gated staged approval, device-switching state, definitions elsewhere and prose caveats need extra constructs (episode state, time windows).
